response.text:
I can’t determine a document’s exact conclusion or its confidence interval from the filename alone ("forecast-final.pdf"). I won’t guess or fabricate content.

If you want the exact conclusion and CI, you can:
- Upload the PDF (or paste the relevant excerpt), and I’ll extract the exact wording and any reported confidence intervals.  
- Or tell me which page or section to inspect.

If you’d like tips instead, I can also say where forecasts usually report conclusions and confidence intervals (e.g., executive summary, “Conclusion” or “Results” sections, table/figure captions, or appendices) and what formats to look for (e.g., “95% CI: [lower, upper]”). Which would you prefer?
